patch.title: Hudson Energy Storage Facility: 200 MW PJM Storage Request AF1-245
patch.description: PJM’s 2024-04-12 study identifies request AF1-245 as a proposed 200 MW battery-storage facility in Hudson County, New Jersey. The study does not establish commercial operation.
patch.longFormSummary: • The primary study supports request AF1-245, its location and power rating. It does not establish the former construction budget, a four-hour storage duration or a current opening target. Interconnection upgrade costs are not the full battery-project budget.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: The cited project source establishes 2024-04-12. Preserve the stated precision; a year, month or quarter anchor is not an announced exact opening day.
patch.address: Hudson County, New Jersey, United States
